description: Let \(f:A\to N\) be partial elementary between nonempty structures, let \(\varphi(x;A)\) be a unary formula, and let \(r\in\mathbb N\). Its solution set in the source has at most \(r\) elements if and only if its solution set in the target, with the parameters moved by \(f\), has at most \(r\) elements.
